spec.title: Set Matrix Zeroes
taskFacts: Given a nonempty rectangular integer matrix, every row and column that originally contains a zero must be made entirely zero.
Modify the supplied matrix in place. A constant-extra-space method is an optional follow-up, not a mandatory requirement.
constraints: The matrix must be changed in place.

examples.explanation: Only the originally zero-containing row and its first column are cleared.
The top row and left column are cleared.
